title: Shipped compose makes the graph anonymously readable and grants Editor to any unassigned authenticated key

title: Erasure deletes the Pod resource but the RuVector embedding row persists and stays searchable, now with a second reader

title: The append-only provenance ledger cannot be re-derived, has no backup, and nothing in the trace read path reads it
